summary: Millicom International Cellular S.A. furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, a Q3 2026 earnings release, and a press release dated November 5, 2026. The results reflect full consolidation of Colombia Telecomunicaciones (Coltel) following the February 6, 2026 acquisition of a 67.5% stake, plus Tigo Uruguay and Tigo Ecuador consolidated from October 2025, and re-presentation of discontinued operations. No special-situation transaction, offer, or structural change is proposed; this is a routine periodic earnings filing.
